austintress: They issued Dorian Austintress a rifle, a spade and a number. He kept a key to a house that is no longer there in his breast pocket, where the shrapnel would have to go through it first.
The colonel shook hands with the first hundred, one by one. Dorian Austintress was number 11. He still remembers how cold the colonel's glove was.
The new duty roster listed Dorian Austintress as a chaplain. He kept checking the old roster until someone took it down.
Clear night. Dorian Austintress counted stars until a flare went up and drowned them all.
Valentin "Crow" Hodnepijumal and Dorian Austintress made a pact on sentry tonight: whoever gets home first visits the other's family. They shook on it with frozen hands.

Dorian Austintress lent Marek Ditrih a pencil. The returned pencil came wrapped in a scrap of paper marked 'One good turn'. The sergeant read out the order: Verdel Ridge has fallen, hold the line. Dorian Austintress looked at the new recruits coming up the road and counted them.

During a lull at Saint-Ash crossroads, Dorian Austintress called across from the Hegemony line. Edmund Fts answered from the Concord side with a perfect imitation of an officer. Both trenches went quiet.
A recruit asked Dorian Austintress how to write an address. He brought paper and began with the largest letters on a ration label.

Wiring party. Dorian Austintress held the coil while two others pulled. Twenty yards of new wire at R-F12, and everyone came back. Hill 304 has been won. Dorian Austintress listened as the corporal read the news twice, once for the men just off watch.

The bread was divided with a ruler. Dorian Austintress received the smallest piece and the job of looking after the ruler. Mail came up the line with a letter for Dorian Austintress. Dorian Austintress read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Dorian Austintress and the recruit have reached whole words. Lessons take place beside the stove, with spelling corrections from people pretending not to listen. Mail came up the line with a letter for Dorian Austintress. Dorian Austintress read it in the dugout and kept the envelope. Dorian Austintress left the work of a chaplain to become a sniper. Someone from the old section came over to see how it was going.

Dorian Austintress let the enemy fix the same sandbag three times. The fourth time, Ivo "Ghost" Lettersabcd was badly wounded. Mail came up the line with a letter for Dorian Austintress. Dorian Austintress read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.
The listening post reported scraping beyond the wire. Dorian Austintress waited through an hour of it before a loose stake was found.

No rifles, only shovels and knives. Dorian Austintress dropped into the Concord trench by a dugout door and met Konrad "Crow" Kagr coming out. It was over in seconds. (@k4a.gr) Victory at Blackwater Canal. Dorian Austintress let himself talk about leave for the first time in days.

Dorian Austintress polished a spoon until he could see a small, bent version of his face. It looked unimpressed with supper too. Grey Mill is in Hegemony hands. Dorian Austintress watched the map being corrected and wondered how such a small pencil mark could take so much work.
Dorian Austintress noticed regular flashes from a crack in an old stone wall. The position looks obvious enough to make him suspicious.
Cyril "Doc" Zaboravljeni and Dorian Austintress spent an hour hunting rats with a bucket and a piece of cheese. Score at dusk: rats 4, soldiers 1.
Out on the wire with the wiring party. A bullet grazed Dorian Austintress's ribs at R-F12. He found the hole in his coat first and the wound second.

The medic looked at Dorian Austintress's wound, sniffed it, and sent him back to R-F12. Clean, said the medic. It is the best word a medic knows. The chaplains took Dorian Austintress in on a busy morning in R-F12. By noon he had learned the first rule of the job, and by evening the second.

Dorian Austintress laughed at something nobody else had heard. Asked to share it, he admitted remembering a conversation from years ago. A letter for Dorian Austintress came all the way from home in nine days. Dorian Austintress counted them on the envelope.
A single shot from across the wire hit Dorian Austintress in the thigh at R-F12. He crawled the last yards on his elbows. Shot by Cyril "Mud" Sann of the Concord (@senkoo_sann0).
Dorian got well on a stretcher in the trench behind R-F12, with a canvas sheet for a roof and the squad for a nurse.
castlecrasher1: After 9 days of war, S-R3 had a place for everything. On Day 9, the men rearranged a shelf to make a place for Valentin "Shadow" Castlecrashe.

Valentin "Shadow" Castlecrashe wrote the range on the back of a ration card: 380 yards. Then Valentin "Shadow" Castlecrashe used it. Isidor Tylermontygr was gravely wounded. Day 10. The Hegemony took Blackwater Canal. From the heights Valentin "Shadow" Castlecrashe could see the whole Concord line, and for the first time the war looked winnable.

Valentin "Shadow" Castlecrashe let the enemy fix the same sandbag three times. The fourth time, Gustav Simplepach was grazed. A letter from home reached Valentin "Shadow" Castlecrashe before dusk. Valentin "Shadow" Castlecrashe read it twice and slept a little easier. On Day 11, Grey Mill passed to the Hegemony. Valentin "Shadow" Castlecrashe wrote the name in his diary with unusual care.
Valentin "Shadow" Castlecrashe did not want to shoot today. Then the enemy shot first, and Valentin "Shadow" Castlecrashe fired back. Pavel Saturdaynigh was grazed.
Valentin "Shadow" Castlecrashe's spoon vanished during supper. He scratched a mark into a replacement and began keeping a closer eye on the washing bucket.

A second spoon disappeared. Valentin "Shadow" Castlecrashe searched the washing area and found a gap behind the board where everyone left cutlery to dry. A letter from home reached Valentin "Shadow" Castlecrashe before dusk. Valentin "Shadow" Castlecrashe read it twice and slept a little easier.
A bullet went through Valentin "Shadow" Castlecrashe's sleeve at S-R3 and took some skin with it. He kept the sleeve. Shot by Lucien "Smokes" Grouchyfish of the Concord (@grouchyfish89541).

Valentin "Shadow" Castlecrashe was put on light duty at S-R3: peeling potatoes, sorting mail, and complaining. There was a letter for Valentin "Shadow" Castlecrashe. Someone at home had drawn a small picture in the corner. Valentin "Shadow" Castlecrashe laughed for the first time in days.
The medics cleaned Valentin "Shadow" Castlecrashe's wound one last time and pronounced him fit. He is back to full duty at S-R3.
A bullet skipped off a rock and cut Valentin's ear at S-R3. He cursed, wrapped it in a sock, and stayed at the post. Shot by Otto Summacon of the Concord (@summacon1).
coreyjmcmichael: Cyril "Rabbit" Coreyjmcmich arrived with the evening ration party, carrying a bullet that missed him and a borrowed greatcoat two sizes too big.
Cyril "Rabbit" Coreyjmcmich answered the first call, number 23 on the rolls. Somebody chalked the number on his helmet. It has not washed off yet.
Cyril "Rabbit" Coreyjmcmich had a letter from home. He read it four times and then once more out loud, for the men who never get any.
News that the Concord had taken Verdel Ridge reached Cyril "Rabbit" Coreyjmcmich during supper. The same stew suddenly tasted better.
A sneeze blew dust off the shelf above Cyril "Rabbit" Coreyjmcmich. This caused another sneeze and a discussion about moving the shelf.
Cyril "Rabbit" Coreyjmcmich found an old map of the Brickworks from before the war. There was a school on it, and an orchard. He looked for them. He did not find them.

The trench wall shook against Cyril "Rabbit" Coreyjmcmich's shoulder during the bombardment. He pressed both feet into the boards and waited for the next hit. The Hegemony took Hill 304. Cyril "Rabbit" Coreyjmcmich watched the officer move a pin on the map and ask for more digging tools.
Cyril "Rabbit" Coreyjmcmich saved a seat for someone fetching supper. Holding it against three hungry men turned out to be hard work.
Cyril "Rabbit" Coreyjmcmich caught a falling mug with his boot. Nobody could say if it was skill or luck, and he did not say either.
A man asked Cyril "Rabbit" Coreyjmcmich to describe Dunmarrow without mentioning the weather. He began with the steepest street and ended with the cheapest lunch.
An enemy patrol scattered in front of S-F10. Cyril "Rabbit" Coreyjmcmich fired at the last man to run. Roland Acquillae was grazed.
News of the loss of Blackwater Canal reached S-F10 with the rations. Cyril "Rabbit" Coreyjmcmich ate while listening to the revised orders.

Cyril "Rabbit" Coreyjmcmich had been watching the same gap for an hour. When Bastian Jt crossed it, Cyril "Rabbit" Coreyjmcmich fired. Bastian Jt was grazed. Grey Mill is lost. Cyril "Rabbit" Coreyjmcmich heard the news from a runner, said nothing, and checked his rifle twice. There will be another race.
A bullet went through Cyril "Rabbit" Coreyjmcmich's sleeve at S-F10 and took some skin with it. He kept the sleeve. Shot by Otto Carlingiti of the Hegemony (@carlingiti).
The medic looked at Cyril "Rabbit" Coreyjmcmich's wound, sniffed it, and sent him back to S-F10. Clean, said the medic. It is the best word a medic knows.
Cyril "Rabbit" Coreyjmcmich kept Yann Coreyxpainte awake all night with questions about home: the street, the shop, the dog. By morning Rabbit could have walked there blind.
The whole squad at S-F10 fired five rounds rapid. The squad agrees it was Cyril "Rabbit" Coreyjmcmich's bullet that found Bastian Jt, badly wounded.

Cyril "Rabbit" Coreyjmcmich was on watch at S-F10 when the night raid hit. The men found Cyril "Rabbit" Coreyjmcmich at dawn by the dugout door. Killed in the night raid by Matthias Mihai of the Hegemony (@angel._.mihai).
Lucien Coreyjmcmich asked about Cyril "Rabbit" Coreyjmcmich on arriving at S-F10. The first story concerned a stolen breakfast. He asked for another.
Lucien Coreyjmcmich fired at the flash of a shovel across the wire. Behind the shovel was Karel "Doc" Jennyschrade, now badly wounded.

Lucien was shot through the shoulder at S-F10. He kept hold of the rifle until the bearers pried it loose. Shot by Benedikt "Crow" Hanka of the Hegemony (@hanka_b97). Lucien was killed at S-F10 reaching for a cup of tea. The cup was still warm when they found it.
The House of Coreyjmcmich sent Benedikt Coreyjmcmich after Lucien Coreyjmcmich. This time the family packed two pairs of spare socks.
deadeyesimulacrum: The new rifleman gave his name as Tobias Deadeyesimul. The corporal looked at his boots, then at the mud, and laughed for the first time in a week.
Volunteer number 12. The quartermaster pinned the First Wave ribbon on Tobias Deadeyesimul's tunic and said: 'Don't let the mud have it.'

Tobias Deadeyesimul found a shirt button in the bread. He ate around it and kept the button. Both were useful. The Concord won Verdel Ridge. In R-F13, Tobias Deadeyesimul listened to three explanations and trusted none of them.
A pocket watch went along the bench so everyone could set the time. Tobias Deadeyesimul has no watch, but checked it anyway, just to feel included.
The kettle lid rattled whenever the conversation stopped. Tobias Deadeyesimul put a folded cloth beneath it and immediately missed the noise.

A shell knocked in the parapet at R-F13. Tobias Deadeyesimul was dug out of the sandbags bruised, coughing, and furious. Victory at Hill 304. Tobias Deadeyesimul let himself talk about leave for the first time in days.
Stitches out, sleeve rolled down. Tobias Deadeyesimul is whole again, or near enough for the line.
Tobias Deadeyesimul had been watching the same gap for an hour. When Jonas "Owl" Askey crossed it, Tobias Deadeyesimul fired. Jonas "Owl" Askey was grazed.

Tobias Deadeyesimul (Hegemony) watched Clement Breadcrumb (Concord) drag a wounded man back across no man's land at the Drowned Farm, and held fire until both were gone. A letter from home found Tobias Deadeyesimul before the night shift. Tobias Deadeyesimul folded it small and kept it close.

Tobias Deadeyesimul was made Lance Corporal after keeping the section together under fire. He asked that the rest of the section be mentioned too. A letter from home found Tobias Deadeyesimul before the night shift. Tobias Deadeyesimul folded it small and kept it close.

Twenty yards of mud, one gap in the wire, one jump. Tobias Deadeyesimul landed next to Oskar Hawkenram in the Concord trench. Only Tobias Deadeyesimul climbed back out. (@hawkenram) The Concord sentry, Benedikt Durham, shouted once. Tobias Deadeyesimul silenced the shout with the flat of a shovel and was back over the parapet a minute later. (@gunnar_durham2325) On the way back from the night raid a flare went up. Tobias Deadeyesimul was caught in the open and hit before reaching the wire. An orderly waved the bearers in: one bed, cleared and scrubbed. Tobias Deadeyesimul was lifted onto it in the hospital dugout. The Hegemony flag went up over Blackwater Canal. Tobias Deadeyesimul did not cheer. He sat down on a sandbag and ate his ration slowly, like a man with time again. A letter from home found Tobias Deadeyesimul before the night shift. Tobias Deadeyesimul folded it small and kept it close.

Tobias Deadeyesimul wrote half a letter home from bed, then tore it up. It said he was fine. It was not a convincing lie. A letter from home found Tobias Deadeyesimul before the night shift. Tobias Deadeyesimul folded it small and kept it close. Grey Mill is in Hegemony hands. Tobias Deadeyesimul watched the map being corrected and wondered how such a small pencil mark could take so much work.

The field hospital let Tobias Deadeyesimul go. He came back up the line on foot because the truck would not wait. A letter from home found Tobias Deadeyesimul before the night shift. Tobias Deadeyesimul folded it small and kept it close.

Tobias Deadeyesimul counted the stitches in a darned sock while waiting for orders. Whoever fixed it had used three colors of wool. A letter from home found Tobias Deadeyesimul before the night shift. Tobias Deadeyesimul folded it small and kept it close.

Tobias Deadeyesimul crawled out with the wiring party. When a flare went up, he lay still and counted to ten. The wire at R-F13 holds again. A letter from home found Tobias Deadeyesimul before the night shift. Tobias Deadeyesimul folded it small and kept it close.
Tobias Deadeyesimul was cleaning the rifle when a head showed across the wire. Load, aim, fire. Anselm Erikvukk was badly wounded.

Night raid. Tobias Deadeyesimul crossed no man's land, saw the enemy sentry too late to reach, and came back without a scratch. Next time, says Tobias Deadeyesimul. There was a letter for Tobias Deadeyesimul and a little tobacco folded inside. The tobacco went round the squad. The letter did not.

Tobias Deadeyesimul saw a helmet rise behind the enemy sandbags at R-F13 and fired once. Lucien Ewalters was badly wounded. Tobias Deadeyesimul fired at a movement across the wire at R-F13. The man went down: Otto Zicharyafour, badly wounded.
Tobias fixed the bayonet, then thought better of it and fired instead. Across the wire, Teodor Warrior was badly wounded.
finnius_33: Pavel Finnius, a railway porter from Halden, was sent forward on Day 6 to fill a gap in R-S6. The gap had a name once. Nobody says it.
Pavel Finnius carried in Pip, who lied about his age to enlist. Pip kept asking whether his mother would be told.
The company barber offered a choice of haircuts. Pavel Finnius asked to see the second one. The barber laughed.
Pip has a fever. Pavel Finnius sits with him after every shift and reads to him from a book with the last pages missing.
Pavel Finnius brought sandbags forward and found the damage worse than the message had said. The party went back for another load.
Blackwater Canal has been won. Pavel Finnius listened as the corporal read the news twice, once for the men just off watch.

Pavel Finnius felt a hard tug at his hip at R-S6. The bullet had cut through his belt and the skin under it. He tied the belt back together with string. Shot by Rafael Real of the Concord (@colt2real). The clerk counted the names twice. Pavel Finnius is number 413 of the first thousand to answer the call, and wears the ribbon of the First Thousand. The Hegemony took Grey Mill, and the orders at R-S6 changed before the cheering ended. Pavel Finnius shouldered another load.

A bullet went through Pavel Finnius's upper arm at R-S6 and broke the bone. He held the arm across his chest and walked half the way back before his legs gave out. Shot by Jonas Miked of the Concord (@miked8903).
Someone moved Pavel Finnius's stretcher out of the doorway. It was the most anyone did for him all day, and he was grateful.
A medic stopped by Pavel Finnius's stretcher every few hours for a week. Today the medic found it empty. Pavel Finnius had gone back to R-S6.
Pip was put on the hospital train today, alive. He gave Pavel Finnius a button from his tunic. Pavel Finnius wears it on his own.

A bullet hit Pavel Finnius in the back as he turned to pass ammunition along at R-S6. He went down on the duckboards and the men shouted for the bearers. Shot by Yann "Ghost" Qhmullaney of the Concord (@qhmullaney). A rifle cracked from the far side of no man's land. Pavel Finnius fell at R-S6 and never moved again. Shot by Yann "Ghost" Qhmullaney of the Concord (@qhmullaney).
Karel "Whistle" Finnius put a bullet that missed him beside the bunk. Someone who had known Pavel Finnius helped clear the shelf without saying why.
Karel "Whistle" Finnius found an old shopping list inside a coat pocket. Soap, lamp oil, apples. He folded it along the original creases.

Karel was hit twice in the leg at R-S6. The medic cut the trouser open with scissors and said nothing useful. Shot by Edmund "Tin" Prohunterwh of the Concord (@prohunterwh). A rifle shot from the far side killed Karel at R-S6. The men on either side did not know until he slid down the wall.
Another member of the House of Finnius reached the line: Anselm "Doc" Finnius. He asked where Karel "Whistle" Finnius had slept, then chose a different corner.
foxeye5: Bram Foxeye walked into N-F14 on Day 13 and asked where the war was. A shell answered before anyone else could.
The wind carried away the last words of every order. Bram Foxeye waited until the corporal came closer before picking up anything heavy.
Bram Foxeye owes Dorian Hld so many cigarettes that they stopped counting and started writing it down. The notebook is nearly full.

Bram Foxeye jumped into the Concord trench and swung the shovel at the first shape that moved. It was Viktor K. The Concord medics will be busy. (@_k__98_) In the dark of the Concord trench Bram Foxeye hit Karel Lazh with a trench club, then ran for the wire before the flares went up. (@_lazh_)

Bram Foxeye was hit badly at Saint-Ash crossroads. The medics worked on him in the bottom of the trench and shouted for a bed. Nobody could reach Bram Foxeye in time. He died on a stretcher by the aid post wall, one of too many waiting.
Walter "Owl" Foxeye arrived carrying the family name of Bram Foxeye. The corporal asked how to pronounce his first name, and waited for the answer.
The parcel for Walter contained six left socks. By supper, he had found three men willing to trade.
hodnepijumaloctu: Nobody asked Valentin "Crow" Hodnepijumal why he came. Nobody in R-F12 asks that. He was handed a spade before he was handed a rifle.
Valentin "Crow" Hodnepijumal is one of the first hundred to answer the call. He wears the ribbon of the First Wave.
On sentry duty Valentin "Crow" Hodnepijumal watched the wire for six hours. Twice he thought the wire watched back.
Edmund "Hollow" Biwott of the Concord threw a tin of tobacco into the Hegemony trench with a note: "for the one who sings". Valentin "Crow" Hodnepijumal kept the tin.

Valentin "Crow" Hodnepijumal and Dorian Austintress made a pact on sentry tonight: whoever gets home first visits the other's family. They shook on it with frozen hands. The report confirmed that the Concord held Verdel Ridge. Valentin "Crow" Hodnepijumal read the last line twice, looking for something the first reading had missed.

Dawn watch. Valentin "Crow" Hodnepijumal put a round across no man's land and the enemy line went quiet: Clement "Saint" Yokley, grazed. Now serving as a sapper, Valentin "Crow" Hodnepijumal discovered that being experienced at the front did not prevent being new at the job.

Valentin "Crow" Hodnepijumal remembered the tune but not the words. Six men offered six different songs, and none of them helped. A letter from home reached Valentin "Crow" Hodnepijumal before dusk. Valentin "Crow" Hodnepijumal read it twice and slept a little easier.

Valentin "Crow" Hodnepijumal raised his head for a heartbeat too long at R-F12. The bullet only grazed him. He will not do it again. Shot by Felix Kagr of the Concord (@k4a.gr). Hill 304 has been won. Valentin "Crow" Hodnepijumal listened as the corporal read the news twice, once for the men just off watch.
Valentin "Crow" Hodnepijumal's bandage came off today. The scar is ugly. He is rather proud of it.

A bucket appeared above the Concord parapet at the Hanging Bridge. Valentin "Crow" Hodnepijumal fired. Ivo "Ghost" Lettersabcd pulled the bucket down. Later a sign went up: 'Water costs enough already.'

The gas alarm sounded during supper. Valentin "Crow" Hodnepijumal put the bread down carefully and did not finish it until the all-clear. A letter from home reached Valentin "Crow" Hodnepijumal before dusk. Valentin "Crow" Hodnepijumal read it twice and slept a little easier.

A bullet hit the sandbag beside Valentin "Crow" Hodnepijumal. He ducked, and noticed his hands were shaking. He kept working anyway. A letter from home reached Valentin "Crow" Hodnepijumal before dusk. Valentin "Crow" Hodnepijumal read it twice and slept a little easier.

A flare, boots, a short fight in the dark at R-F12. Valentin "Crow" Hodnepijumal was killed before the rest of the squad was even awake. Killed in the night raid by Ulrich Alessiosanto of the Concord (@alessiosantori).

The papers say Ulrich Hodnepijumal. The sergeant says he has his father's eyes. Valentin "Crow" Hodnepijumal's eyes. Nobody in R-F12 argues. Ulrich Hodnepijumal's First Wave ribbon drew a question at supper. He remembered the queue at the depot more clearly than the speech. Ulrich Hodnepijumal reported for duty as a sapper. The new kit was heavier than the explanation of how to use it.

An empty jam tin became Ulrich Hodnepijumal's cup. The first drink still tasted of strawberries. He took small sips. A letter from home reached Ulrich Hodnepijumal before dusk. Ulrich Hodnepijumal read it twice and slept a little easier. Victory at Grey Mill. Ulrich Hodnepijumal let himself talk about leave for the first time in days.
The patrol came back one man at a time. Ulrich Hodnepijumal held the gap open and counted until the corporal said that was everyone.
Ulrich Hodnepijumal checked the safety catch three times before handing over the post. The man taking over noticed, and checked it once more.
The cook's stew tasted of iron and smoke. Ulrich Hodnepijumal ate two helpings anyway.

A bullet bounced off the trench wall and caught Ulrich Hodnepijumal across the shin at R-F12. It bled a lot and meant very little. Shot by Tobias "Ash" Alierayyagiy of the Concord (@alierayyagiyanik).
The medic looked at Ulrich Hodnepijumal's wound, sniffed it, and sent him back to R-F12. Clean, said the medic. It is the best word a medic knows.
Ulrich Hodnepijumal of the Hegemony and Matthias "Brick" Ols of the Concord have been shooting at the same tin can on the wire at Lantern Hill for a week. Both trenches keep score.

Ulrich was hit in the thigh at R-F12. He crawled behind a sandbag and called for the bearers in a voice nobody had heard from him before. Shot by Valentin "Button" Boi of the Concord (@gremlin_boi32). An orderly waved the bearers in: one bed, cleared and scrubbed. Ulrich was lifted onto it in the field hospital.
iamthreatnotyou: Benedikt "Ash" Iamthreatnot introduced himself as a dance-hall violinist from Wyvern Cross. The corporal repeated the name correctly. That helped more than the advice.
The Hegemony secured Blackwater Canal. Benedikt "Ash" Iamthreatnot helped pass the news along the line, checking each time that he had heard correctly.

Benedikt "Ash" Iamthreatnot and Tobias Padraiggalla compared drawings of home. Both drawings included a kitchen table larger than the house. A thousand names now stand in the regimental book. Benedikt "Ash" Iamthreatnot is number 944. The sergeant pinned the ribbon of the First Thousand on without a speech. Word came down the line: Grey Mill is ours. Benedikt "Ash" Iamthreatnot shook hands with a corporal he had never spoken to. Today, everyone was a friend.
Benedikt "Ash" Iamthreatnot found a shirt button in the bread. He ate around it and kept the button. Both were useful.
Benedikt "Ash" Iamthreatnot watched fog gather on the wire until every strand carried beads of water. The sentry beside him called it expensive fencing.
Out on the wire with the wiring party. Benedikt "Ash" Iamthreatnot tore his hands on the barbs and did not make a sound. The new wire at S-F5 is up.

A bullet hit the sandbag next to Benedikt "Ash" Iamthreatnot's ear at S-C13 and sprayed his face with grit and blood. A scratch, the medic said, and a lucky one. Shot by Anselm "Mole" Kjwthe of the Concord (@kjwthe1). Benedikt "Ash" Iamthreatnot bought War Bonds for the front. The quartermaster pinned the ribbon on personally: 'The front remembers who kept it fed.' Benedikt "Ash" Iamthreatnot was invited to the Officers' Mess for keeping the front supplied. The colonel poured a real coffee and raised his cup: 'The front does not forget its friends.' The quartermaster had a German shepherd pup nobody wanted. Benedikt "Ash" Iamthreatnot took it and called it Lassie. The whole squad already spoils it.
Three days with a bandage, and Benedikt "Ash" Iamthreatnot is back at S-C13. He says the food at the aid post was worse than the food in the trench. Nobody believes him.
Benedikt "Ash" Iamthreatnot wrote to his mother, who writes every Sunday. He did not mention the shelling. He mentioned the stars.
Benedikt set a charge under the enemy listening post. Then he waited all night for an order that did not come.
joelauramorrow: By the time Quentin Joelauramorr reached R-S7, the war was 6 days old and had its own habits. He learned the first one within the hour: keep your head down.
A recruit asked Quentin Joelauramorr how to write an address. He brought paper and began with the largest letters on a ration label.
Quentin Joelauramorr and the recruit have reached whole words. Lessons take place beside the stove, with spelling corrections from people pretending not to listen.
The recruit wrote a first short letter without Quentin Joelauramorr's help. He was allowed to check the envelope, but not the contents.
After the loss of Blackwater Canal, Quentin Joelauramorr helped stack spare sandbags at R-S7. Nobody asked when they would be needed.

Quentin Joelauramorr repaired a collapsed wall of the trench at R-S7 with sandbags, boards and language not fit for letters home. Quentin Joelauramorr got a narrow grey ribbon today, the ribbon of the First Thousand. Number 435. The men who came later will ask about it. The sergeant read out the order: Grey Mill has fallen, hold the line. Quentin Joelauramorr looked at the new recruits coming up the road and counted them.
A reply arrived for the recruit. Quentin Joelauramorr listened while it was read aloud, slowly, without once supplying a word.

A bullet struck Quentin Joelauramorr below the ribs at R-S7. He kept asking whether the post was still manned until the bearers took him away. Shot by Oskar "Whistle" Jozifanderso of the Hegemony (@jozifanderson). Quentin Joelauramorr had marked the enemy's path to the latrine on a scrap of paper. Today it paid off: Jakub You, badly wounded. Quentin Joelauramorr was killed at R-S7 just after dawn. The cup of tea beside him was still hot. Shot by Oskar "Whistle" Jozifanderso of the Hegemony (@jozifanderson).
The House of Joelauramorr sent another. Viktor Joelauramorr, brother of Quentin Joelauramorr, arrived with the same eyes and the same stubborn silence.
Viktor Joelauramorr and Wendel Goober made a pact on sentry tonight: whoever gets home first visits the other's family. They shook on it.
Viktor Joelauramorr taught a recruit to recognize letters by sound. By supper, the whole table was tapping out Morse on the planks.
A letter reached Viktor Joelauramorr from Stoneyford. The streets there still have names. He read them out loud, one by one.
Viktor Joelauramorr and Konrad Tripletonyt divided a parcel using a tin lid as scales. The last crumb needed a second opinion.
Viktor cut wood for the stove at the support dugout. The stack is higher than the dugout.
joshuahudson943: "You're late," said the corporal when Bram "Whistle" Joshuahudson arrived on Day 15. "Everyone's late. Get a spade."

Bram "Whistle" Joshuahudson traded for a better blanket and got a reputation as a sharp dealer. The man who lost it wants a rematch. A short letter reached Bram "Whistle" Joshuahudson: everyone is well, the dog misses you. Bram "Whistle" Joshuahudson read the part about the dog twice.

Jonas "Button" Lajambe kept Bram "Whistle" Joshuahudson awake all night with questions about home: the street, the shop, the dog. By morning Button could have walked there blind. A letter from home reached Bram "Whistle" Joshuahudson before dusk. Bram "Whistle" Joshuahudson read it twice and slept a little easier.

Bram read a page of Marek Sonkeixrp's diary by accident. Bram did not tell, but was kinder for a week. Bram read the letter, folded it, unfolded it, and read it again. The sentry pretended not to see.
kstoner69: On Day 9 Walter Kstoner took a post at S-R3 that had been empty for two nights. He did not ask why. He sleeps with his boots on, and the men liked him for it.

A bullet found Walter Kstoner at S-R3, high in the shoulder. He went down hard and stayed down. Shot by Jakub Thefunkmuffi of the Hegemony (@thefunkmuffin16). The bearers reached Walter Kstoner at S-R3 too late. One shot, and it was over. Shot by Jakub Thefunkmuffi of the Hegemony (@thefunkmuffin16).
Silas Kstoner arrived carrying the family name of Walter Kstoner. The corporal asked how to pronounce his first name, and waited for the answer.

A round went through the rim of Silas Kstoner's helmet and nicked his ear on the way out. He has a notch in both now. Shot by Quentin "Rabbit" Kcls of the Hegemony (@bri3kcls). Silas Kstoner got a narrow grey ribbon today, the ribbon of the First Thousand. Number 959. The men who came later will ask about it. The report confirmed that the Hegemony held Grey Mill. Silas Kstoner read the last line twice, looking for something the first reading had missed.
Back on the fire step at S-R3. Silas Kstoner says the wound itches, which the medics say is a good sign.
Silas Kstoner borrowed a serial novel from a newspaper bundle. The instalment ends with a locked door and a pistol shot. The next issue is missing.
Splinters from a shell rained down on S-R3. Silas Kstoner took one in the shoulder and had it dug out right there on the fire step.
Silas Kstoner returned to S-R3 with a fresh bandage and orders to keep it dry. He has already broken the second part.
A round went through Silas Kstoner's water bottle and into his thigh, but not far. He is more upset about the water. Shot by Quentin "Rabbit" Kcls of the Hegemony (@bri3kcls).

A single shot from across the wire hit Silas Kstoner in the thigh at S-R3. He crawled the last yards on his elbows. Shot by Gustav Heyyybigmike of the Hegemony (@heyyybigmike). Silas Kstoner was carried to the aid post and straight back out. Full. He waits on a stretcher by the door, holding his brother's pocket watch.
The medics called Silas 'the corridor man', because he lay there so long. Today the corridor is empty. Silas is back on the line.
misahmisery: Jakub "Button" Misahmisery introduced himself as a stonemason from Lindenbruck. The corporal repeated the name correctly. That helped more than the advice.

A sniper's bullet hit Jakub "Button" Misahmisery at V-F8. The medics worked on him in the bottom of the trench and shouted for a stretcher. Shot by Casimir Lilly of the Concord (@_bell_lilly_). Jakub "Button" Misahmisery was killed on watch at V-F8. The men found his rifle still resting on the parapet, aimed at the spot the shot came from. Shot by Casimir Lilly of the Concord (@_bell_lilly_).
Gideon Misahmisery had heard about Jakub "Button" Misahmisery's courage. At V-F8, he also heard about the snoring, the cards and the terrible handwriting.
The new soap slipped into the wash bucket. Gideon Misahmisery fished it out by feel and then had to wash again.

A bullet found Gideon Misahmisery at V-F8, high in the shoulder. He went down hard and stayed down. Shot by Roland Cody of the Concord (@mcdonnell_cody). Outside the aid post, Gideon Misahmisery lies on a stretcher among the others. The orderlies step over him and say soon.
A medic brought Gideon Misahmisery half a cup of soup and a promise. The soup was real.
Gideon did not last the night outside the full aid post. The bearers who carried him in carried him out again at dawn.
Ivo "Crow" Misahmisery took the same post at V-F8 where Gideon Misahmisery stood. He found his brother's initials carved in the wall and put his own beneath them.
suppahneggah: Gustav Suppahneggah came up on Day 9 carrying news from Old Harrow. A man interrupted to ask whether the railway clock had been repaired.

Day 10: Blackwater Canal was lost. Gustav Suppahneggah wrote down the news without trying to explain it. Mail came up the line with a letter for Gustav Suppahneggah. Gustav Suppahneggah read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

The last of the jam was shared by scraping it onto a biscuit. Gustav Suppahneggah approved the method. The sergeant read out the order: Grey Mill has fallen, hold the line. Gustav Suppahneggah looked at the new recruits coming up the road and counted them.
The trench wall shook against Gustav Suppahneggah's shoulder during the bombardment. He pressed both feet into the boards and waited for the next hit.
The whole squad at Q-F21 fired five rounds rapid. The squad agrees it was Gustav Suppahneggah's bullet that found Felix Bro, grazed.
A tin cup glinted on the enemy parapet. Gustav Suppahneggah aimed just below it. Gustav Obrien was badly wounded.
Gustav Suppahneggah did not want to shoot today. Then the enemy shot first, and Gustav Suppahneggah fired back. Walter Goggles was badly wounded.
Gustav Suppahneggah fired twice at the enemy post. The second shot found Konrad "Doc" Mekli, gravely wounded. Nobody nearby said anything.
At Q-F21 the men had a bet on who would hit something first. Gustav Suppahneggah won the bet. Ivo Obrien was grazed.
Someone had labelled the water bucket 'Soup'. Gustav changed it back after lunch, too late to settle the argument.
weep_te: On Day 9, Silas Weep arrived during an argument about a missing spoon. The war already had matters more urgent than introductions.
News of the loss of Blackwater Canal reached S-C10 with the rations. Silas Weep ate while listening to the revised orders.

Silas Weep found a clean spot on the table and set his bread on it. Within a minute, someone asked to borrow the spot. Silas Weep got a narrow grey ribbon today, the ribbon of the First Thousand. Number 623. The men who came later will ask about it. Grey Mill fell to the Hegemony. Silas Weep kept the newspaper; he wanted to remember exactly what had been promised beforehand.
Silas Weep counted the stitches in a darned sock while waiting for orders. Whoever fixed it had used three colors of wool.
A newspaper reached Silas Weep with the corner torn off. According to the half a sentence that survived, the war was going well.
Silas Weep tried to remember the price of a loaf in Old Harrow. Three different answers seemed right, depending on how far back he thought.
The men have learned that Silas Weep is superstitious about the number three. Tonight it made them laugh, which was worth a great deal.
Silas Weep was hit by a shell splinter at S-C10 while running for the dugout. He made it to the steps and no further.
Silas Weep spent the day on a stretcher outside the aid post, waiting for a bed to come free. The bearers brought water twice.
Silas healed on a stretcher under a canvas sheet, with the bearers stepping over him day and night. He thanked each one by name before leaving.
wo1yer: The old hands of S-S3 have been here since Day 1. Edmund "Ash" Yer has been here since Day 8. In a trench, that difference already feels like years.
Thunder shook dust from the beams over Edmund "Ash" Yer. For once, nobody blamed the enemy.
Day 10. Blackwater Canal fell to the Hegemony. Edmund "Ash" Yer watched their flag go up on the heights and dug his trench a little deeper.

Edmund "Ash" Yer was hit in the thigh crossing Verdel Ridge. He crawled the last yards back to the trench on his elbows. A thousand names now stand in the regimental book. Edmund "Ash" Yer is number 532. The sergeant pinned the ribbon of the First Thousand on without a speech. Day 11: Grey Mill was lost. Edmund "Ash" Yer wrote down the news without trying to explain it.
Edmund "Ash" Yer never saw the inside of the aid post. The medics changed his dressings on the stretcher until the wound closed. He is back on the line.
A round came through a gap in the sandbags at S-S3 and grazed Edmund "Ash" Yer's arm. Two inches, the sergeant said. Shot by Ulrich "Smokes" Badbadmannnn of the Hegemony (@badbadmannnn).
The medic looked at Edmund "Ash" Yer's wound, sniffed it, and sent him back to S-S3. Clean, said the medic. It is the best word a medic knows.

Edmund "Ash" Yer had just lit a cigarette at S-S3 when a bullet cut a line across his cheek. He finished the cigarette before going to the medic. Shot by Casimir Dunkmyanactu of the Hegemony (@dunkmyanactual).
A bullet struck Edmund "Ash" Yer below the ribs at S-S3. He kept asking whether the post was still manned until the bearers took him away. Shot by Rafael "Parson" Olo of the Hegemony (@d5olo2010).
No bed for Edmund "Ash" Yer yet. A medic checked the bandage and promised him a place as soon as one opened up.
For days Edmund was too weak to sit up on the stretcher. This morning he sat up, then stood, then asked for his rifle.
